name: avocado-os-mcp-server

scripts.test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cd build-test && node --test
scripts.test:watch: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && (tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --watch & TSC=$!; trap 'kill $TSC 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; cd build-test && node --test --watch)
scripts.checks: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck

author: Avocado Linux
description: MCP server for Avocado OS. Helps an AI assistant get a user up and running: pick a target, init a project, search packages, author and validate avocado.yaml, work with references, diagnose build / provision failures.
